assessment: This paper will be of considerable interest to familial hemiplegic migraine type 1 (FHM) sufferers who may experience traumatic brain injury (and their physicians), as well researchers with an interest in the spectrum and phenotypic consequences of mutations in the voltage-gated, P/Q-type Ca2+ channel, CACNA1A. The authors demonstrate that patients carrying a gain-of-function S218L missense mutation in CACNA1A exhibit a gene-dosage-dependent increase in the susceptibility to cortical spreading depolarization (CSD), seizure activity, and brain edema formation following TBI.
